name: plugin-packaging
description: Repair a skills-only Claude plugin that fails to install, load skills or find its resources. Use when colleagues cannot install a package that works locally, a plugin manifest points at the wrong directory, plugin dependencies do not resolve, or missing skills and broken references appear after distribution. Paste manifests, a file inventory, configs, errors or an installation transcript. Get a package audit, corrected text or authorized local file repairs, and a loading receipt from supplied traces or requested harmless checks through an available named host. Not for new scaffolding, improving one skill’s answers, or team administration.
